title: More Cookies
description: This is a Remake of a old mod called More Cookies that like the name says adds more cookies the original mod download is at the bottom
body:
This is a mod i made a really long time ago its been recovered cause i found it in my google drive folder thats why the only original version is 1.2.0 i have remade this mod and now still updating it it adds more cookies to the game like the name says the cookies that where added include:
1. M&M Cookie
2. Sugar Cookie
3. Black & White Cookie
4. Fortune Cookie
5. Gingerbread Cookie
6. Raisin Cookie
7. Lofthouse Cookie
8. Chocolate Cookie
9. Chocolate Sugar Cookie
10. Chocolate M&M Cookie
11. Chocolate Raisin Cookie

it also adds other items so you can get the cookies including:
1. Chocolate Bar
2. M&M
3. Raisin
